hero.title: Case studies & R&D highlights.
hero.text: How we apply AI, computer vision and IoT to practical challenges — and the research that keeps our solutions ahead.

empty.title: Case studies are coming soon
empty.text: We are preparing detailed write-ups of recent work. In the meantime, we are happy to walk you through relevant projects in a conversation.

rnd.title: Where our research is focused
rnd.text: Applied research that feeds directly into the systems we deliver.

areas.title: Edge AI for video analytics
areas.text: Efficient models that run on compact hardware next to the camera, reducing bandwidth and latency.

areas.title: Multi-modal sensor fusion
areas.text: Combining video, radar, acoustic and IoT telemetry for more reliable detection and fewer false alarms.

areas.title: Situational awareness
areas.text: Real-time operational pictures that bring together geospatial data, events and alerts.

areas.title: Document & language intelligence
areas.text: Large language models and retrieval that turn unstructured documents into structured, searchable knowledge.

areas.title: Predictive maintenance
areas.text: Forecasting equipment failures from sensor patterns so maintenance happens before downtime.

areas.title: Privacy-preserving vision
areas.text: On-device processing, anonymisation and data minimisation built into computer-vision pipelines.

cta.title: Have a technology challenge worth solving?
cta.text: Bring us the problem. We’ll help shape the requirements, choose the architecture and build the solution.
